title: i18n catalogue sources — provenance
provenance: The 9 machine catalogues in src/core/i18n-catalogs/*.gen.ts cited scripts/gen-catalogs.mjs and scripts/i18n-work/<lang>.json in their headers, but neither existed in the repo, so the catalogues could not be regenerated. On 2026-11-20 the checked-in catalogue contents were reverse-extracted into these JSON files, restoring a regenerable pipeline. The translations themselves are UNCHANGED from the frozen snapshot: no translation was invented, corrected, or re-translated in the extraction.
knownIssues: No record survives of which machine-translation provider/model produced the snapshot, and there was no glossary enforcement or human review (ROADMAP Phase 2 requires both). Treat every entry as unreviewed MT until reviewed.

Hindi was 832 keys behind the other catalogues at extraction (2603 vs 3435). The generator fills missing keys with the English source string (value == key); scripts/i18n-audit.mjs reports those as untranslated. Real Hindi translations for those keys are still owed.
5 CSS-fragment keys were dropped at extraction as extractor noise (see quarantinedCssKeys). They were never UI text.
value == key entries are mostly legitimate (IFC entity names, acronyms, key names) but are counted by the audit so genuine gaps are visible.
